transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri. The report from the village states that seven homes were destroyed by the force of your Love Breathing during the battle. You know our rules about civilian protection. Why did you act with such force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I... I am deeply sorry for the damage caused. In the heat of the battle, I could not control the force of my Love Breathing as well as I should have. I did not mean to cause such destruction to the innocent.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your apology is noted, Mitsuri. However, the Demon Slayer Corps exists to protect humanity, not to leave them homeless. Tell me, what was the nature of the demon you faced that required such overwhelming force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The demon, Oyakata-sama, was a particularly resilient Upper Rank. It had the ability to absorb damage and convert it into physical strength. I had to apply as much force as possible to subdue it, and... I failed to reign in my power in time. I understand now that I must be more careful with my technique.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: An Upper Rank... that is indeed a formidable foe. Yet, even against such an opponent, we must maintain discipline. Did you consider alternative strategies to draw the demon away from the village before engaging with your full strength?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I should have been more thoughtful, Oyakata-sama. In my haste to protect the villagers, I did not take the time to assess the best approach. I was focused on ending the threat as quickly as possible, and in my urgency, I failed to consider the potential consequences of my actions. I am truly sorry for my lack of foresight.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your desire to protect is commendable, Mitsuri, but haste without foresight can cause as much harm as the demons we fight. The villagers you saved now have no homes to return to. How do you propose we make amends for this?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You are right, Oyakata-sama. The damage has been done, and it is our responsibility to rectify it. I would like to take it upon myself to lead a team to rebuild the destroyed homes. We can use our slayer abilities to hasten the process and ensure the villagers have a safe place to return to. Additionally, I will contribute a portion of my salary to assist the affected families until they can resume their lives. I believe this is the least we can do to make amends for the distress we have caused.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A practical and sincere proposal. I will authorize the rebuilding effort under your supervision. But understand this, Mitsuri: your strength is a gift, but it must be tempered with control. I expect you to reflect deeply on this incident and ensure it does not happen again. The trust of the people is our foundation.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Oyakata-sama. I will not let you down. I promise to take the necessary steps to improve my control over my Love Breathing and to always consider the consequences of my actions before acting. The trust of the people is indeed our foundation, and I will do everything in my power to preserve and strengthen it. I will also take this opportunity to share my experience with the other slayers, so we can all learn from my mistakes.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well. Your willingness to learn and make amends speaks well of your character. Proceed with the rebuilding, and report to me when it is complete. You are dismissed, Mitsuri.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your understanding, Oyakata-sama. I will not辜负您的信任。 I will begin the rebuilding effort immediately and will report back once it is finished. I am committed to becoming a better slayer and a more responsible member of the Demon Slayer Corps. I hope to earn back the trust of both you and the people we serve.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go with care, Mitsuri. Remember that true strength lies not only in power, but in the wisdom to wield it justly.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will never forget your words, Oyakata-sama. True strength does indeed lie in wisdom and self-discipline. I will carry this lesson with me always, and I will strive to be a slayer who not only possesses power, but also the judgment to use it wisely and justly. With your guidance, I believe I can grow into a better protector of humanity.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your resolve is clear. I trust you will honor your words with action. You may go now.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will, Oyakata-sama. I am ready to take on this task with renewed focus and determination. Thank you for your patience and guidance. I will not let you down. I will leave now to begin the rebuilding effort, with the hope that I can soon report back with good news.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: May your efforts bring peace to those you have troubled. Go, and may you find the balance you seek.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will, Oyakata-sama. Your words are a comfort to me, and I will carry them with me as I work to repair the damage I have caused. I am determined to find the balance between my power and my responsibility, and I am grateful for your guidance in this process. With your blessing, I will now depart to carry out this important work.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go in peace, Mitsuri. Let your actions speak for your heart.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will, Oyakata-sama. Your kind words are a great comfort to me, and I will hold them close as I embark on this mission of atonement and service. I promise to let my actions reflect my true intentions, and to always act with the best interests of the people in mind. With your guidance, I will strive to be a better slayer, and a better person. I am now ready to begin the work that lies ahead.
